title: Existence of a lifted multiplicative product before its ring laws
statement: Let A be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], complete for an ideal I [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Let f:X to Spec A be separated and finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism], X_n = X times_{Spec A} Spec(A/I^(n+1)), and j_n:X_n to X [def-pc-base-change]. Let i_n:X_n to X_(n+1) satisfy both canonical pullback projection equations. Let c_n:i_n^*j_(n+1)^* to j_n^* be the inverse of the pinned tensorPullbackCompositionIso [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso]. Let p_n:Y_n to X_n be finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], with g_n:Y_n to Y_(n+1) cartesian over i_n and g_n p_(n+1) j_(n+1) = p_n j_n. Let G be coherent [pqf-def-coherent], with support proper over Spec A [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. Suppose psi_n:j_n^*G isomorphic to p_(n,*) O_Yn and i_n^*(psi_(n+1)) followed by the module base-change map and p_(n,*) of the structure-sheaf pullback map equals c_(n,G) followed by psi_n [lem-weil-pbc-affine-pushforward-base-change]. Let a_n:G to (p_n j_n)_* O_Yn be the pinned adjoint of psi_n followed by pushforward composition [lem-weil-pbc-finite-structure-adjoint-transitions]. Then there exists an O_X-linear map mu:G tensor G to G [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] with a_n(mu(x tensor y)) = a_n(x)a_n(y) on every open U and for every pair of sections x,y of G on U. This assertion imposes no associativity, commutativity, unit, or uniqueness.

proof.text: The tensor square is coherent and has proper support by the proved tensor-powers lemma.

Write P_n = j_n^*, Q_n = i_n^*, and delta_n for the tensor comparison. Choose the canonical reduced products m_n characterized on pure tensors by multiplication on O_Yn, and set v_n = delta_n followed by (psi_n tensor psi_n), m_n, and psi_n inverse. The base-change algebra formula gives Q_n(m_(n+1)) followed by beta = delta_i followed by (beta tensor beta), then m_n.

The pinned composition mate satisfies c_(n,G tensor G) followed by delta_n = Q_n(delta_(n+1)) followed by delta_i, then (c_(n,G) tensor c_(n,G)). Take adjoints and use its unit identity; evaluate on pure tensors and apply the sheaf tensor universal property. Substitute this identity, hpsi, naturality of delta_i, and the base-change product formula into v_n. Cancel psi_n to get c_(n,G tensor G) followed by v_n = Q_n(v_(n+1)) followed by c_(n,G).

Fullness of completion for the coherent proper-support square and G lifts v_n to mu. Evaluate its reduction equation after the pinned adjunction unit. The tensor comparison sends the unit image of x tensor y to the tensor of the unit images of x and y. Following by psi_n and pushforward composition gives a_n(mu(x tensor y)) = a_n(x)a_n(y).

        (Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChangeMap (fnY (n + 1)) (fnY n) (i n) (gn n)
          (hcart n).flip.w (SheafOfModules.unit (Yn (n + 1)).ringCatSheaf) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (fnY n)).map
            (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit (gn n))) =
        (c n).hom.app G ≫ (ψ n).hom) :
    ∃ μ : G ⊗ G ⟶ G,
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens),
        let a : Γ(G, U) → Γ(Yn n, (fnY n ≫ pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
